nar.text: Snow covers the high mountain roads after a night of heavy rain.
The starts took place perfectly but the popular Campari had to stop just 200 meters from the start due to a breakdown with engine valves.

Ascari's Fiat was over the first 50 kilometers the fastest until he grazed one of the road marker stones, he carried on with unchanging speed and overturned in a corner immediately after Polizzi.
Ghia demolished the front axle of his Diatto when he crashed into a wall on the first lap near Polizzi and retired.
The first car arriving at the grandstand was that of Thomas who had passed the six cars that had started ahead of him.
Thomas stops six minutes for tyres; Landi passes him.
Boillot skids over the road border near the grandstand, is stopped by a pile of stones, frees the car and goes on; he leads on adjusted time.

On the second lap, the battle continued with Boillot leading Thomas by seven minutes. Giulio Masetti passed Gamboni for third place.
Campari's race ended due to a miscalculation in a corner in the middle of the second lap, suffering tire cuts, steering failure and inability to continue.
Boillot refuels on the move: a can of fuel is thrown to his mechanic, who empties it into the tank.

Boillot refuels on the move: a can of fuel is thrown to his mechanic, who empties it into the tank.
On the third lap Thomas was now closer, only 73 seconds apart from Boillot. Moriondo had passed Gamboni and Giulio Masetti for third place.
Boillot stops once, refuelling and fitting smooth rear tyres as the roads dry.

Boillot stops once, refuelling and fitting smooth rear tyres as the roads dry.

On the fourth lap, Boillot kept the lead but Thomas, who had been warned of the fast Peugeot and thus had raised his pace, retired near Caltavuturo when he spun against a road marker stone and broke the differential.

A hundred meters from the finish, the road was blocked by a wall of spectators opposite the grandstand. He braked hard, the car spun three times, then darted into the flimsy wooden structure below the grandstand.
Boillot crosses the line backwards, is told that is a violation, turns round and crosses again, half an hour ahead of Moriondo.
Gamboni's Diatto finished third followed by Giulio Masetti's Fiat, Negro's Nazzaro, Carlo Masetti's Aquila-Italiana, Sivocci's CMN and Baldoni's Nazzaro in eighth place.
